sourceChecks.claim: Azure gateway design identifies reverse proxy, service routing and shared concerns; same-product load balancing is explicitly supported by gateway-routing.

Azure offloading specifies TLS termination, separate verified backend TLS, common policy savings, bypass protection and service-specific limits. Bounded body rejection is a sound concrete admission policy.
OWASP explicitly requires verifiable propagated user identity, separately authenticated service, prevention of gateway bypass and resource/business authorization within the service.

Azure rate-limit policy documents per-key429, retry-after and distributed inaccuracy. Two independent allowances sum to200; strict coordinated accounting is a derived requirement, not a guarantee of that product policy.
AWS timeout/retry article confirms timeout can follow successful side effects and retries consume resources; whole-path deadline accounting is consistent with its bounded waiting guidance.
AWS idempotency article supports stable caller tokens and atomic mutation/token recording; retry multiplication and single-owner policy also supported by AWS timeout/retry article.
Azure aggregation explicitly supports bounded optional partial results versus failed required results and recommends dedicated services for complex domain composition.
Azure routing documents common failure/bottleneck, load testing and poor fit for simple services; replica/shared-dependency limitations are correct necessary-condition reasoning.
